intro: Government and healthcare sectors were the primary targets in a series of XSS attacks documented across nine articles from May 9 to May 16, 2026. The coverage highlighted vulnerabilities including CVE-2026-44567, CVE-2026-45303, CVE-2026-45314, CVE-2026-44579, and CVE-2026-44580, with severity scores ranging from 7.5 to 7.7. The affected regions were global, spanning business services, e-commerce, and education alongside the leading sectors. The severity mix comprised four high, four medium, and one low severity incident.
